svg.title: DIA-004B · The shortest stave
svg.desc: An engraved plate of an open wooden tub built of staves of unequal height and bound by two iron hoops. Water stands inside exactly level with the top of the shortest stave and spills over it, down the outside, into a puddle on the floor. One stave is drawn in a dashed rust outline rising far above the rest: Anthropic's binding pause commitment. Its sawn-off length lies on the floor beside the tub, dated 24 February 2026. The taller stave never held any more water than the shortest one allowed.
svg.text: PART I · SECTION 4 · WHO WAS SUPPOSED TO SLOW IT
“We felt that it wouldn't actually help anyone for us to stop training AI models.”
JARED KAPLAN OF ANTHROPIC, TO TIME
The water line is the standard.
It never held any more water.
Four revisions since. Not put back.
DIA-004B · A tub fills only to its shortest stave. A safety commitment taller than a rival's adds wood, not water.
